runs.v: As a rule of thumb, once damage covers about 25% of a roof, roof replacement usually beats repeated roof repair; in New Jersey, repairing or replacing more than 25% of the roof area within 12 months on a commercial, multi-family, or attached building also needs a permit under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7. That matters before a green roof goes on, because replacing the membrane later means removing the planting.
